title: Arbitrarily High-Order Convergence of Wavelet-based Galerkin Scheme for 1D Elliptic Interface Problems
summary: The solution $u$ of an elliptic interface problem in a domain $Ω$ is often smooth away from the interface $Γ\subset Ω$, but its gradient is discontinuous across $Γ$. Consequently, $u$ has low global regularity and generally does not belong to $H^{3/2}(Ω)$. This paper studies 1D elliptic interface problems using wavelet methods. We propose a Galerkin method based on compactly supported biorthogonal wavelet bases on bounded intervals with approximation order $m$, for any integer $m \ge 2$.
